# matterbridge_commissioning (Resource)

Sends a commissioning command to a Matter server node, as the buttons of the frontend do. The apply sends the command when it creates the resource and when trigger changes. A plan or a refresh never sends it. Destroy does nothing. The resource cannot remove a fabric.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Opens the commissioning window, so that a new Matter controller can pair. Change trigger to open it again.
resource "matterbridge_commissioning" "window" {
  action  = "open"
  trigger = "2026-11-03"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `action` (String) open (open the commissioning window, so that a new controller can pair), close (close the window), or advertise (announce the node again with mDNS). A change to action alone does not send the command.
- `trigger` (String) Change this value to send the command again, for example a date.

### Optional

- `node` (String) The server node: Matterbridge (the default, bridge mode), or a plugin name in childbridge mode.

### Read-Only

- `advertising` (Boolean) True if the node advertised after the last command.
- `id` (String) The node.
- `window_status` (Number) The commissioning window after the last command: 0 closed, 1 enhanced, 2 basic.
